svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Committing Capital
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutes-and-exposure; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Committing Capital; subtitle: Every check must pass; unresolved evidence means no purchase.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: These are sequential checks, not a jurisdiction-complete rulebook. Select applicable state ticket licensing, transfer and tax rules for each transaction. A blocked branch returns to evidence collection or rejects the opportunity.; caption: A lawful acquisition channel, accurate price, documented resale treatment and funded downside must exist before execution.; stages: label: Acquisition rights and BOTS Act; value: Proceed only with documented authorized acquisition; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. section 45c: no queue, CAPTCHA or ticket-limit circumvention. Reject resale covered by the statute's knowledge or participation conditions. Verify suite and stadium seat license transfer restrictions.; label: Displayed prices and local permissions; value: Proceed only with correct covered total prices; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 16 CFR Part 464 to covered ticket offers, including required total-price prominence and permitted exclusions. Verify applicable state all-in pricing, reseller licensing and venue-specific transfer requirements before listing.; label: Resale and shipment documentation; value: Proceed only with applicable tax and delivery evidence; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Validate resale-certificate eligibility under applicable state rules; California purchases may invoke 18 CCR section 1668. Document shipment risk under adopted UCC section 2-509 and verify insurance exclusions.; label: Cash coverage and loss capacity; value: Proceed only with funded settlement-delay downside; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Require cash coverage for card obligations despite delayed ACH, issuer shutdown or frozen exchange payouts. Set counterparty concentration limits and pre-event stop-loss markdown curves before acquiring inventory.

text.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Committing Capital
text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Committing Capital

rect.title: label: Acquisition rights and BOTS Act; value: Proceed only with documented authorized acquisition; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Apply 15 U.S.C. section 45c: no queue, CAPTCHA or ticket-limit circumvention. Reject resale covered by the statute's knowledge or participation conditions. Verify suite and stadium seat license transfer restrictions.

text.title: Apply 15 U.S.C. section 45c: no queue, CAPTCHA or ticket-limit circumvention. Reject resale covered by the statute's knowledge or participation conditions. Verify suite and stadium seat license transfer restrictions.

rect.title: label: Displayed prices and local permissions; value: Proceed only with correct covered total prices; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 16 CFR Part 464 to covered ticket offers, including required total-price prominence and permitted exclusions. Verify applicable state all-in pricing, reseller licensing and venue-specific transfer requirements before listing.

text.title: Apply 16 CFR Part 464 to covered ticket offers, including required total-price prominence and permitted exclusions. Verify applicable state all-in pricing, reseller licensing and venue-specific transfer requirements before listing.

rect.title: label: Resale and shipment documentation; value: Proceed only with applicable tax and delivery evidence; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Validate resale-certificate eligibility under applicable state rules; California purchases may invoke 18 CCR section 1668. Document shipment risk under adopted UCC section 2-509 and verify insurance exclusions.

text.title: Validate resale-certificate eligibility under applicable state rules; California purchases may invoke 18 CCR section 1668. Document shipment risk under adopted UCC section 2-509 and verify insurance exclusions.

rect.title: label: Cash coverage and loss capacity; value: Proceed only with funded settlement-delay downside; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Require cash coverage for card obligations despite delayed ACH, issuer shutdown or frozen exchange payouts. Set counterparty concentration limits and pre-event stop-loss markdown curves before acquiring inventory.
